thread:
maria: Heads-up: Kestrel load test next Tue needs a temporary burst in europe-west3. Need 8x NVIDIA A100 (40GB) non-preemptible + 45 external NAT IPs for container egress. GCP project: redwood-kestrel-prod. Estimate 6h runtime. Can we open a quota case now? cc @samir @jess

samir: Sounds good. Please include projected vCPU and GPU quota numbers and whether these must be non-preemptible. We may need non-preemptible for stable perf.

maria: Confirmed non-preemptible. Targets: A100-40GB x8 (request to raise GPU quota to 12 to be safe), vCPU +320 (nodes are 32 vCPU each), External IPs +45. Duration: 6h + 2h buffer. Expected token volume ~2B tokens for stress validation.

samir: Ok I'll open the GCP support case. Any billing code to attach? cc @jess

jess: Provisional approval BG-2026-Q2 up to $14k for this burst. Keep runtime <= 8h total. If we look like we’ll exceed that, stop and alert finance.

samir: Opening case now. Created GCP case #9876543210. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/9876543210 (internal). Assigned to escalation tier 2. cc @maria @gcp-support-bot

gcp-support-bot: Case 9876543210 — created and assigned. Current status: OPEN. Initial response ETA: 18–24 hours. Suggestion: request TAM involvement for faster handling. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: We need a faster turnaround — test is Tue morning (UTC). Please mark this as same-day escalation and add 'P0: capacity impact / scheduled customer test' to the case notes.

samir: Escalation note added: 'P0 - urgent booking for scheduled customer load test'. Requested TAM contact. I've DM'd our TAM.

gcp-support-bot: Support update: if escalated, assigned engineer will reach out within 6–12h. Providing fleet metrics and traffic pattern helps. Uploading load profile now.

maria: Uploaded load profile + node config (pasted):
```
node_type: n1-standard-32
gpus_per_node: 1
image: redwood-runtime:v2.3
network: shared-vpc-prod
nat_ips_needed: 45
```
Please confirm exact quota lines we requested in the ticket.

samir: Requested quota increases in the case: GPU (A100) +8 -> target total 12, vCPU +320, External IPs +45, regional egress quota bump to cover ~10Gbps. Ticket updated.

jess: Finance noted. Tag product-ops if any customer-facing comms change.

maria: Added fallback plan to the case: if A100s unavailable, fallback to A10G x12 with ~8% model perf regression — documented.

samir: Good. Also opening an AWS fallback ticket for ap-southeast in case europe capacity isn't available. Drafting a short runbook for the window.

runbook-bot: New draft runbook created: 'eu-west3-gpu-burst-2026' at /docs/runbooks/eu-west3-gpu-burst.md. Please review.

samir: Final note — once support confirms quota changes, I'll schedule the reserve and tag infra oncall for the deployment window.

maria: Thanks — please ping #incidents or @oncall if GCP returns partial approvals. :crossed_fingers:
